ps.en: Dr. Han's [[premise]] was modest: that a school rises or falls on the quiet [[preparation]] of its teachers, not on the size of its budget. She had gathered much of her evidence from [[overseas]] systems that everyone praised and few had studied. Her grant application was [[rejected|reject]] in eleven days; the reviewers found the argument interesting but not [[relevant]].
ps.zh: 韩博士的前提很朴素：一所学校的兴衰，取决于教师平日不显眼的准备，而非预算的规模。她的证据多来自海外那些人人称赞、却少有人研究的体系。拨款申请十一天就被驳回了，评审意见是：论点有意思，但不切题。

ps.en: She did not [[rejoice]] when a rival study confirmed her data; she asked what her own model had [[overlooked|overlook]]. The answer was [[reflection]] — not more data, but time for teachers to [[reflect]] on their own classrooms. What followed was a five-year [[reform]] of one poor district, documented with the patience of a physicist: every gain weighed with [[relativity]], against what it had cost elsewhere.
ps.zh: 当对手的研究证实了她的数据时，她并没有庆幸，而是追问自己的模型忽略了什么。答案是反思——不是更多的数据，而是让教师回望自己课堂的时间。此后是五年对一个贫困学区的改革，记录方式带着物理学家般的耐心：每一项收获都用相对性来衡量，对照它在别处付出的代价。

ps.en: The [[relation]] between funding and results, she wrote, is [[relative]] to trust; the [[relationship]] between teacher and student outweighs any curriculum. Only one official asked whether her findings [[related|relate]] to city schools, and whether a [[premium]] should be paid to those who stayed longest. Her answer filled forty pages, and it opened with her premise again.
ps.zh: 她写道，经费与成效之间的关联是相对于信任而言的；师生关系胜过任何课程表。只有一位官员追问：她的发现是否也适用于城市学校，以及是否该给那些坚守最久的教师发放额外津贴。她的答复写了四十页，开头仍是那个前提。

ps.en: The famine began quietly, as famines do: first the [[statistics]] bent, then the markets. In the capital a [[statesman]] old enough to remember two wars stood before parliament and read a single [[statement]] — the [[state]] would guarantee a minimum [[standard]] of food for every citizen. Outside, rain streaked the [[statue]] of the republic's founder, who had [[starved|starve]] as a young officer and never forgotten it.
ps.zh: 饥荒总是静悄悄地开始：先是统计数字弯了下去，然后是市场。首都一位经历过两场战争的老政治家站到议会前，宣读了一份简短的声明——国家将向每一位公民保障最低的食物标准。议会外，雨水划过共和国奠基者的雕像；他年轻时挨过饿，一生未曾忘记。

ps.en: The [[statute]] that followed ran to forty pages and was written in the dry voice of lawyers. From every [[standpoint]] it was imperfect: farmers said the price was too low, merchants said the targets too high, and the treasury, whose [[status]] had just been downgraded, said both. The old man took a firm [[stance]] — compromise now, refinement later — and dared the opposition to [[stand]] against bread. His allies called him [[stern]]; his enemies called him slow.
ps.zh: 随后出台的法令长达四十页，通篇是律师式的干巴巴措辞。从任何立场看，它都不完美：农民说收购价太低，商人说指标太高，刚被下调评级的财政部则说两者都对。老人态度坚定——先妥协，后完善——并放话让反对派来反对面包试试。盟友称他严厉，对手称他迟缓。

ps.en: The programme did not [[start]] with grain but with salt and cooking oil, and that startled no one; what [[startled|startle]] the capital was where the riots stopped. Step by [[step]] it moved — county granaries first, then city queues — each one kept [[steady]] by clerks who had learned to [[steer]] panic into patience. Families chose to [[stay]], and the exodus began to [[stem]]. By winter the law's defenders could stand on street corners without guards, and the old statesman, visiting the founder's statue in the snow, said nothing at all.
ps.zh: 这项计划最先配发的不是粮食，而是盐和食用油，这没有让任何人吃惊；让首都吃惊的是骚乱停下的地方。它一步一步推进——先是县城粮库，然后是城市排队点——每一步都靠一群学会了把恐慌疏导成耐心的职员维持平稳。一家人家选择留下，外流的势头开始被遏制。到了冬天，法案的捍卫者已经不用卫兵就能站在街角；而老政治家踏着雪去看奠基者的雕像，一言未发。

ps.en: The warning arrived at dawn: an [[anonymous]] letter, posted three days earlier, saying only that the square would remember that Friday. The police did not [[anticipate]] a real threat — public figures had weathered worse — and by noon a crowd began to [[assemble]] for the weekly [[assembly]] of the reform movement. The violence lasted four seconds: a man drew a pistol, a bodyguard moved, and what was meant to [[assassinate]] a minister became, on ten thousand phone screens, an [[assault]] upon the idea of assembly itself.
ps.zh: 警告在黎明时送到：一封三天前寄出的匿名信，只说「这个广场会记住那个星期五」。警方没有料到真正的威胁——公众人物经历过的风浪多了——中午前，人群开始聚集，参加改革运动每周的集会。暴力只持续了四秒：一名男子拔出手枪，一名保镖迎上去；一场原本意在暗杀部长的行动，在一万块手机屏幕里，变成对整个集会理念的袭击。

ps.en: In the aftermath the city lived on a diet of [[anxiety]] and rumour. Families [[anxious]] about the curfew were held [[apart]] at the checkpoints, and hospitals asked visitors not to [[assert]] kinships they could not prove. The one thing everyone shared was the need to [[comprehend]] what had happened; the one thing no one could [[compose]] was a sentence equal to it.
ps.zh: 事件之后，这座城市靠焦虑和谣言度日。为宵禁担心的家庭在检查站被分隔开来，医院则要求探视者不要声称无法证明的亲属关系。所有人共同的需要是理解发生了什么；而没有人写得出一个配得上它的句子。

ps.en: Months later the inquiry released its [[comprehensive]] report: four hundred pages on every [[component]] of the failure, from the lost letter to the unguarded gate. Its central [[composition]], a chapter titled The Week Before, read like a novel and indicted like a verdict. The [[answer]] to why the letter had been ignored, the report concluded, was the oldest in public life: nobody wanted it to be true. The city read it in silence — a kind of understanding, if not yet full [[comprehension]].
ps.zh: 数月后，调查组公布了全面的报告：四百页篇幅，写尽失败链条上的每一个环节——从那封丢失的信，到无人看守的大门。它的核心章节《前一周》写得像小说，定罪却像判决书。报告总结道：那封信为何被无视，答案出自公共生活里最古老的那一条——没有人愿意它是真的。全城沉默地读完了它：这是一种理解，尽管还算不上彻底的理解。

ps.en: When the [[conductor]] Wei An agreed to [[conduct]] the provincial orchestra, he found the hall in a [[condition]] his students would have failed: roof cracked, scores mouldering, the rehearsal regime a museum of old habits. The players had talent but no [[discipline]]; the board had opinions but no money. He accepted anyway, on one condition — that nobody call the task impossible within his hearing.
ps.zh: 指挥家韦安答应执掌省交响乐团时，发现音乐厅的状况放到他的学生手里都不及格：屋顶开裂、乐谱发霉、排练制度像一座陈列旧习惯的博物馆。乐手有天赋却没有纪律；理事会有意见却没有钱。他还是答应了，只提了一个条件——不许当着他的面说这件事不可能。

ps.en: Auditing the accounts, the new manager made a [[discovery]] that would [[disappoint]] the board's chairman: a decade of 'emergency loans' had [[disappeared|disappear]] into a private fund. She did not [[disclose]] it at once; she let the auditors [[discover]] it themselves, then read the findings aloud at the meeting. The board voted to [[condemn]] the practice and hand it to the prosecutor. One member warned that the orchestra itself would be tainted. Wei replied that silence was the worse stain.
ps.zh: 新任经理查账时有一个发现，它注定要让理事会主席失望：十年的「紧急借款」竟消失在一个私人账户里。她没有立刻公开，而是让审计师自己查了出来，再在会议上当众宣读。理事会投票谴责这种做法，并将其移交给检方。一名成员警告说，乐团本身也会蒙上污点。韦安答道：沉默才是更脏的污点。

ps.en: That winter an icy road nearly [[disabled|disable]] the concertmaster's left hand, and for a week the season seemed finished. Wei refused to cancel. He [[condensed|condense]] the programme to five works, hauled the hall's piano onto the stage himself, and told the audience the plain truth on opening night. They came anyway, filling a half-repaired hall; nobody left early, nobody asked for a refund. As one critic wrote, the orchestra had learned to play the condition it was in.
ps.zh: 那年冬天，一条结冰的路几乎让首席小提琴手的左手致残，整整一周，演出季眼看要泡汤。韦安拒绝取消。他把曲目压缩到五部，亲自把厅里的钢琴搬上舞台，并在首演之夜对观众说了大实话。人们还是来了，坐满了一座修了一半的音乐厅；没有人提前离场，没有人要求退票。一位乐评人写道：这支乐团学会了在所处的境况中演奏。

ps.en: The typhoon made landfall at three in the morning, and the fishing village of Lankou met it the way it had met every storm for four centuries: every [[household]] up on the hill, doors [[held|hold]] fast from inside, whole families in one [[huddle]] listening to the roof. By dawn, helicopters were crossing the strait to [[hoist]] the old and the young to safety while the able-bodied stayed to hold the nets and the boats. The village head, [[holder]] of the communal fishing licence for thirty years, stood at the jetty counting heads in the rain.
ps.zh: 台风在凌晨三点登陆，渔村兰口以四百年来的老办法迎接它：每一户人家都上了高地，从里面抵紧家门，全家人挤作一团，听着屋顶作响。天亮时，直升机正越过海峡，把老人和孩子吊运到安全处，能干活的人则留下守网守船。当了三十年渔业执照持有人的村长站在码头上，淋着雨点人头。

ps.en: The [[national|national]] news called it a [[natural]] disaster — the phrase a [[nation]] reaches for when the wind is the only culprit it can name. The village told a different [[narrative]]: mangroves cleared for a resort, a warning buoy left unmoored, a shipping channel cut [[narrow]] where the old maps marked a wide one. [[However|however]] the official report finally phrased it, the [[native]] families knew which part was [[nature]] and which part was choice. Families whose [[nationality]] no one questioned waited on compensation for land their grandmothers had planted. The argument, when it came, turned [[nasty]] within a week.
ps.zh: 国家新闻把它称为自然灾害——这是一个国家在唯一能指认的元凶是风时伸手就能拿到的措辞。村子讲的是另一个版本：为建度假村清掉的红树林、没人固定的警示浮标、在老地图上本该宽阔处被挖窄的航道。无论官方报告最后如何措辞，本地家庭都清楚哪一部分是大自然，哪一部分是人为选择。国籍无人质疑的家庭，在等一块祖辈种过的地的补偿款。争论到来后，一周内就变得难听。

ps.en: The [[overall]] picture took a year to assemble: eleven homes gone, the school saved, the boats sunk. The village did not overcome the storm — no one overcomes a storm — but it [[overcame|overcome]] the settlement, the silence, and the story that had set it apart. The rebuilt school now teaches the old channel names alongside the national curriculum, and on clear mornings the children climb the ridge where, their grandmothers say, you can watch the sea decide.
ps.zh: 总体图景花了一年才拼齐：十一栋房屋没了，学校保住了，船沉了。村子没有战胜风暴——没人能战胜风暴——但它克服了那份和解方案、那段沉默，以及那个把自己说成另类的故事。重建的学校如今在国家课程之外还教老航道的名字；晴朗的早晨，孩子们爬上祖母们说的那条山脊——在那里，你能看着大海拿主意。

c: on the premise that... 在…的前提下
a false premise 错误的前提
business premises 经营场所
fam: premise v. 预先提出
premises n. 营业场所（僻义）
words.dif: premise 指论证推理所依据的假定；assumption 只是未经证明的想法，不一定进入论证链条
words.pat: The plan rests on the premise that every child can learn, given time.
words.patZh: 这个计划基于一个前提：只要给时间，每个孩子都能学会。

c: pay a premium for 为…支付溢价
insurance premium 保险费
at a premium 奇缺；以溢价
fam: premia n. 复数形式
words.dif: premium 指「为更好之物多付的钱」或「保险费」；bonus 指额外奖金，与保险无关
words.pat: Customers will pay a premium for honesty, and charge for its absence.
words.patZh: 顾客愿意为诚实支付溢价，也会为它的缺席开出账单。

c: in preparation for 为…作准备
make preparations for 为…作准备
mental preparation 心理准备
fam: prepare v. → preparation n. → preparatory adj. 预备的
words.dif: preparation 作不可数指「准备过程」；preparations 复数指具体的准备工作，如 make preparations
words.pat: Luck is what preparation looks like from the outside.
words.patZh: 运气，就是准备从外面看起来的样子。

c: reflect on / upon 反思，仔细考虑
reflect sth 反映…
be reflected in 体现在…中
fam: reflection n. → reflective adj. → reflector n. 反射器
words.dif: reflect on 表「反思」（须接 on/upon）；reflect 直接接宾语表「反映」——两义都是考点
words.pat: A budget reflects values more honestly than any speech.
words.patZh: 一份预算比任何演讲都更诚实地反映价值观。

c: on reflection 经再三考虑
a reflection of …的反映
be lost in reflection 陷入沉思
fam: reflect v. → reflection n. → reflective adj. 沉思的
words.dif: reflection 作「倒影」可数，作「沉思」不可数；meditation 多指有系统的冥想练习
words.pat: On reflection, she withdrew the question and kept the friendship.
words.patZh: 再三考虑后，她收回了那个问题，保住了这段友谊。

c: reform the system 改革制度
economic reform 经济改革
reform oneself 改过自新
fam: reformer n. 改革者
reformation n. 改革
words.dif: reform 指在现有框架内改良；revolution 是推翻重建——改革的对象多为制度，revolution 针对政权
words.pat: Reform succeeds when it changes incentives, not just rules.
words.patZh: 改革改变的是激励而不只是条文时，才会成功。

c: reject a proposal 驳回提案
reject sth outright 断然拒绝
be rejected by 被…拒绝
fam: rejection n. → rejected adj. → reject n. 次品
words.dif: reject 语气最硬，含「不采纳并退回」；decline 是婉拒；refuse 泛指拒绝
words.pat: The journal rejected the paper, not the idea; the idea outlived the journal.
words.patZh: 期刊退掉的是论文，不是想法；想法比期刊活得久。

c: rejoice at / over 为…而高兴
rejoice in 因拥有…而欣喜
rejoice to do 因…而欢喜
fam: rejoicing n. 欢庆
words.dif: rejoice 是带文学色彩的「欣喜」，正式而强烈；be glad 口语化且程度轻
words.pat: We rejoiced at the news, then quietly went back to work.
words.patZh: 我们为这个消息而欣喜，然后悄悄回到工作中。

words.exam: 讲述；叙述；使相互关联；联系
c: relate to 与…相关；理解并认同
relate sth to sb 向某人讲述
be related to 与…有关
fam: relation n. → relationship n. → relative n. / adj.
words.dif: relate to 两考：「与…相关」与「理解、认同」（teenagers need adults they can relate to）
words.pat: Readers relate to characters who hesitate, not to those who never doubt.
words.patZh: 读者能与之共鸣的，是会犹豫的角色，而不是从不怀疑的角色。

c: in relation to 关于；与…相比
bear no relation to 与…完全不符
diplomatic relations 外交关系
fam: relate v. → relation n. → relationship n.
words.dif: relation 较抽象、正式；relationship 多指人际或具体关联；relations 复数常指「邦交、交往」
words.pat: Price bears little relation to quality in markets where trust is scarce.
words.patZh: 在信任稀缺的市场里，价格与质量关系不大。

c: a close relationship with 与…的亲密关系
build a relationship 建立关系
working relationship 工作关系
fam: relate → relation → relationship n. 相关延伸
words.dif: relationship 指人际间持续的情感或工作联系；relation 更抽象正式，常用复数指外交关系
words.pat: The best relationships between teachers and students are built on respect, not fear.
words.patZh: 最好的师生关系建立在尊重之上，而非恐惧。

c: a close relative 近亲
relative to 相对于
relative advantage 相对优势
fam: relate → relative n. / adj. → relatively adv.
words.dif: relative 作名词是「亲戚」，作形容词「相对的」常与 to 连用；relevant 是「相关的」，形近义异
words.pat: Success is relative to the obstacles you started with.
words.patZh: 成功是相对于你出发时面对的障碍而言的。

c: the theory of relativity 相对论
relativity of values 价值观的相对性
general / special relativity 广义 / 狭义相对论
fam: relative adj. → relativity n.
words.dif: relativity 物理上指爱因斯坦「相对论」，一般语境指「相对性」；reality（现实）形近音近，最易混
words.pat: Einstein's relativity teaches that even time depends on where you stand.
words.patZh: 爱因斯坦的相对论告诉我们，连时间也取决于你所站的立场。

words.exam: 有关的；切题的；相关联的；有意义的
c: be relevant to 与…相关
relevant experience 相关经验
highly relevant 高度相关
fam: relevance n. → relevantly adv. → irrelevant adj. 无关的
words.dif: relevant 指「与当前问题相关、切题」；relative 指「相对的」——二者只差一个字母，最易混
words.pat: The question is not whether the data are new, but whether they are relevant.
words.patZh: 问题不在于数据是否新颖，而在于它们是否切题。

c: overlook a detail 忽略细节
overlook the sea 俯瞰大海
be easily overlooked 容易被忽视
fam: over + look → overlooked adj.
words.dif: overlook 兼「俯瞰」（本义）与「忽视」（引申，多指无心之失）；ignore 是「故意不理睬」
words.pat: In praising the reform, the report overlooked the teachers who made it work.
words.patZh: 报告在称赞改革时，忽视了让它落地的教师们。

words.exam: 外国的；海外的；在海外；在国外
c: overseas students 留学生
study overseas 在海外求学
overseas markets 海外市场
fam: over + sea(s) → overseas adj. / adv.
words.dif: overseas 可兼形容词与副词（overseas students / go overseas）；abroad 只能作副词，不能说 an abroad student
words.pat: Experience gained overseas often reads as a threat at home.
words.patZh: 在海外获得的阅历，在本土常被读作一种威胁。

words.exam: 站立；位于；维持现状；忍受；经受
c: stand for 代表
stand up for 维护
stand by 支持；袖手旁观
cannot stand doing 无法忍受
fam: stood（过去式）→ standing n. 地位 → standpoint n. 立场
words.dif: stand 表「忍受」只用于否定与疑问（can't stand）；表「代表」须用 stand for
words.pat: Stand for something, or you will fall for anything.
words.patZh: 有所坚守，否则你会对什么都信以为真。

c: meet the standard 达到标准
a high standard of 高水准的…
standard of living 生活水平
up to standard 合乎标准
fam: standardize v. → standardization n.
words.dif: standard 指公认的衡量尺度；criterion 是评判的「准则」，更正式，复数为 criteria
words.pat: The standard you walk past is the standard you accept.
words.patZh: 你走过去的那个标准，就是你接受的那个标准。

c: from a... standpoint 从…的角度来看
from the standpoint of 从…的立场出发
a historical standpoint 历史视角
fam: stand + point → standpoint n.
words.dif: standpoint 强调持论者所处的位置，常与 from 连用；viewpoint 泛指看法，口语色彩更浓
words.pat: From an economic standpoint, the policy was sound; from a human one, it failed.
words.patZh: 从经济角度看，这项政策无可挑剔；从人的角度看，它是失败的。

c: take a stance on 对…表明立场
a firm stance 坚定的立场
a neutral stance 中立态度
fam: stand → stance n.（同源名词）
words.dif: stance 是公开表明的立场态度，仍带身体姿势的联想；standpoint 是看问题的出发点
words.pat: The minister took a firm stance: reform now, refinement later.
words.patZh: 部长表明了坚定立场：先改革，再完善。

c: start with 从…开始
start from scratch 从零开始
make a start 开始动手
to start with 首先
fam: starter n. 起跑者；开胃菜
startle v. 惊吓（同源）
words.dif: start 与 begin 近义；commence 正式，多用于典礼与法律程序；start 还可指「动身、启动机器」
words.pat: Every long journey starts with a decision to take the first step.
words.patZh: 每段长途都始于一个「迈出第一步」的决定。

c: be startled by / at 被…吓了一跳
a startling discovery 惊人的发现
startle sb out of sleep 把某人从睡梦中惊醒
fam: start v. → startle v. → startling adj. 惊人的
words.dif: startle 指突然的短促惊吓；frighten 程度更深更持久；astonish 侧重「难以置信」而非恐惧
words.pat: What startled the committee was not the cost, but the silence of the experts.
words.patZh: 让委员会吃惊的不是成本，而是专家们的沉默。

c: starve to death 饿死
be starved of 极度缺乏…
starve sb into submission 以断粮逼人就范
fam: starvation n. → starving adj. → starveling n. 饿瘦的人
words.dif: starve 本义「饿死」；be starved of 是高频引申，指「极度缺乏」（starved of funds）
words.pat: A budget starved of maintenance is a debt sold to the future.
words.patZh: 维护经费被抽空的预算，是一笔赊给未来的债。

words.exam: 状态；情况；国；州；陈述；说明
c: state clearly 明确说明
in a... state 处于…状态
the state 国家；政府
state of mind 心态
fam: statement n. → statesman n. → statehood n. 州地位
words.dif: state 作动词是正式「陈述」（state the facts）；作名词兼「状态」与「国家」，两义都高频
words.pat: The report states the facts and leaves the conclusions to the reader.
words.patZh: 报告只陈述事实，把结论留给读者。

c: issue / make a statement 发表声明
a written statement 书面陈述
bank statement 银行对账单
fam: state v. → statement n. → restate v. 重申
words.dif: statement 泛指口头或书面的正式陈述；declaration 更庄重，多指官方宣告
words.pat: Her silence was a statement no one in the room could misread.
words.patZh: 她的沉默是一份无人误读的声明。

c: a respected statesman 受尊敬的政治家
an elder statesman 政界元老
statesmanlike judgment 政治家风范的决断
fam: statesman → statesmanship n. 治国才能 → stateswoman n. 女政治家
words.dif: statesman 含褒义，指有远见、以国家利益为重的政治家；politician 常含贬义，指政客
words.pat: A politician thinks of the next election; a statesman, of the next generation.
words.patZh: 政客想着下一届选举，政治家想着下一代人。

words.exam: 统计数字；统计资料；统计学
c: official statistics 官方统计
statistics show that... 统计表明…
according to statistics 据统计
fam: statistic n. 一项统计量 → statistical adj. → statistician n. 统计学家
words.dif: statistics 指统计资料或统计学时谓语用单数；a statistic 才是单个统计数字
words.pat: Statistics show the trend; they do not show the person inside it.
words.patZh: 统计数据呈现趋势，却呈现不了趋势中的那个人。

c: erect a statue 立雕像
a bronze statue 铜像
the Statue of Liberty 自由女神像
fam: statuary n. 雕像群
statuesque adj. 雕像般挺拔的
words.dif: statue 是雕像；statute 是法令；stature 是身高、声望——三个形近词是完形常客
words.pat: The statue outlasted every opinion ever carved beneath it.
words.patZh: 这座雕像比刻在基座下的一切评价都活得长久。

c: social status 社会地位
marital status 婚姻状况
status quo 现状
seek status 追求地位
fam: state → status n.（拉丁借词）→ statute n.（同根异形）
words.dif: status 指社会地位或现状状况；statue 雕像、statute 法令——三个形近词高频同现于选项
words.pat: A title confers status; only conduct keeps it.
words.patZh: 头衔授予地位，唯有品行能守住它。

c: a federal statute 联邦法令
statute law 成文法
under the statute 依据该法令
fam: statutory adj. 法定的
words.dif: statute 是立法机关制定的成文法令；regulation 是行政机关的规章；law 泛指一切法律
words.pat: The statute was four pages long; its consequences filled forty years.
words.patZh: 这条法令只有四页，它的影响却填满了四十年。

c: stay up 熬夜
stay away from 远离
stay in touch 保持联系
stay the course 坚持到底
fam: stayed → staying → stay n. 逗留
words.dif: stay 兼「物理停留」与「保持状态」（stay calm）；remain 更正式，还可接名词表「仍是」
words.pat: In hard times, the question is not who arrives, but who stays.
words.patZh: 艰难时刻，问题不是谁来了，而是谁留了下来。

c: steady growth 稳定增长
a steady hand 沉稳的手法
steady oneself 使自己镇定
fam: steadily adv. → steadiness n. → unsteady adj.
words.dif: steady 指平稳不变的，含可靠之意；stable 强调不易动摇；constant 强调持续不断
words.pat: Markets reward the steady hand and punish the merely clever one.
words.patZh: 市场奖励沉稳的手，惩罚只有聪明的人。

c: steer clear of 避开
steer the conversation 引导谈话
steer a course 把握航向
steer through 引导渡过
fam: steering n. 转向装置
steerage n. 统舱
steersman n. 舵手
words.dif: steer 本义掌舵驾驶，引申为引导走向；guide 泛指引导；drive 侧重驱动推进
words.pat: A good editor steers a writer without ever touching the pen.
words.patZh: 好的编辑引导作者，却从不碰笔。

words.exam: 茎；制止；阻止；遏制；起源于
c: stem from 起源于
stem the tide 遏制势头
stem the bleeding 止血（喻止损）
the stem of a plant 植物的茎
fam: stemmed → stemming → stem n. 词干
words.dif: stem from 表「源于」，stem the flow 表「遏制」——同一词的两个相反方向都是考点
words.pat: Most failures stem from small concessions made very early.
words.patZh: 大多数失败源于很早之前做出的微小让步。

words.exam: 步；台阶；梯阶；步骤；措施；踏；走；举步
c: take steps to do 采取措施
step by step 逐步地
a step forward 前进的一步
watch one's step 小心行事
fam: stepping-stone n. 垫脚石
footstep n. 脚步
words.dif: take steps 表「采取措施」是固定搭配；measure 与之近义但更正式、宏观
words.pat: Reform is not a leap but a series of steps, each defended.
words.patZh: 改革不是一跃，而是一连串每一步都需守住的小步。

c: a stern warning 严正警告
stern measures 严厉措施
be stern with sb 对某人严厉
a stern face 严肃的面孔
fam: sternly adv. → sternness n.
words.dif: stern 指表情、态度的严厉冷峻；strict 指对规则的严格执行；severe 程度最重
words.pat: The teacher was stern about deadlines and generous with second chances.
words.patZh: 这位老师对截止期限毫不通融，对第二次机会却慷慨给予。

c: an anonymous letter 匿名信
remain anonymous 保持匿名
an anonymous donor 匿名捐赠者
fam: anonymity n. 匿名 → anonymously adv.
words.dif: anonymous 指身份不明的；unanimous 是「一致同意的」——形近且同含 -animous，最易混
words.pat: The anonymous donor gave one condition: that the gift never be named.
words.patZh: 那位匿名捐赠者只提了一个条件：这份馈赠永远不被命名。

c: answer for 对…负责
answer to 符合；与…相称
in answer to 作为对…的回应
fam: answerable adj. 应负责任的
words.dif: answer for 是「对…负责」；answer to 是「符合」（answer to a description）；reply 无这两个搭配
words.pat: Leaders must answer for decisions made in rooms they chose to enter.
words.patZh: 领导者必须为自己选择走进的那个房间里作出的决定负责。

c: anticipate a problem 预见到问题
be widely anticipated 被普遍预期
anticipate doing 预计做…
fam: anticipation n. → anticipatory adj. 预想的
words.dif: anticipate 指提前料到并着手准备，比 expect 多一层「预先应对」；后接 doing，不接 to do
words.pat: The wise anticipate the objection before the opponent raises it.
words.patZh: 智者会在对手提出异议之前，就先把异议想到。

c: anxiety about / over 对…的焦虑
ease anxiety 缓解焦虑
growing anxiety 日益加剧的忧虑
fam: anxious adj. → anxiously adv.
words.dif: anxiety 是名词「焦虑状态」；anxious 是形容词，兼表「焦虑的」与「渴望的」，两义方向相反
words.pat: Anxiety is the tax that the uncertain future charges in advance.
words.patZh: 焦虑是不确定的未来提前征收的税。

c: be anxious about 为…担忧
be anxious to do 渴望做…
anxious for change 渴望变革
fam: anxiety n. → anxiously adv.
words.dif: be anxious about（担忧）与 be anxious to do（急切想做）含义相反，靠介词与结构区分
words.pat: The city grew anxious, then angry, and finally organized.
words.patZh: 这座城市先是焦虑，继而愤怒，最后组织了起来。

words.exam: 分离；分开；相隔；相距；成零碎
c: fall apart 破裂
tell apart 区分
apart from 除…之外
set apart 使与众不同
fam: apartment n. 公寓
part n. / v.
words.dif: apart from 既可表「除…之外（还有）」也可表「除…之外（没有）」，两种理解都成立
words.pat: It is pressure that shows what holds a community together — and what sets it apart.
words.patZh: 正是压力显出一个社区靠什么凝聚，又因什么而分离。

c: assassinate a leader 暗杀领导人
an assassination attempt 暗杀企图
be assassinated by 被…暗杀
fam: assassination n. → assassin n. 刺客
words.dif: assassinate 特指暗杀政治要人；murder 泛指谋杀；execute 是依法处决
words.pat: You can assassinate a leader, but not the argument that elected him.
words.patZh: 你可以暗杀一位领袖，却暗杀不了选他出来的那个主张。

c: an assault on sb 对某人的袭击
sexual assault 性侵
launch an assault 发起攻击
assault and battery 殴打与侵犯人身
fam: assaultive adj. 好攻击的
words.dif: assault 指近距离的突然攻击，法律上特指人身侵犯；attack 泛指各种攻击，范围最广
words.pat: The lawsuit described the takeover as a financial assault on the company's future.
words.patZh: 诉讼称这次收购是对公司未来的财务袭击。

c: assemble evidence 汇集证据
assemble a team 组建团队
assemble the parts 组装零件
fam: assembly n. → assembler n. 装配工
words.dif: assemble 兼「集合（人）」与「装配（物）」；gather 只指聚集，不指装配
words.pat: The committee assembled the evidence before it assembled itself.
words.patZh: 委员会先把证据汇集齐，才召集齐人。

c: the General Assembly 联合国大会
assembly line 装配线
freedom of assembly 集会自由
an assembly hall 礼堂
fam: assemble v. → assembly n.
words.dif: assembly 指有组织的集会或工业装配；conference 指正式会议；rally 指群众集会
words.pat: Freedom of assembly matters most when the assembly is unpopular.
words.patZh: 集会自由在集会不受欢迎时才最重要。

c: assert that... 断言…
assert one's rights 维护权利
assert oneself 坚持己见，表现自信
fam: assertion n. → assertive adj. 自信的 → assertiveness n.
words.dif: assert 是坚定地声称，常无证据；affirm 是确认属实；allege 是「据称（未证实）」——三词常同现于法律阅读
words.pat: She asserted her right to be heard before she was judged.
words.patZh: 她坚持自己有权在受评判之前先被倾听。

c: a key component of …的关键组成部分
component parts 零部件
essential components 必要成分
fam: compose v. → component n. / adj.
words.dif: component 指系统或整体中可分离的部件；element 指基本要素；ingredient 多指成分原料
words.pat: Trust is the one component no supply chain can outsource.
words.patZh: 信任是唯一无法外包的供应链环节。

c: be composed of 由…组成
compose a letter 写信
compose oneself 使自己镇定
compose music 作曲
fam: composer n. → composition n. → composite adj.
words.dif: be composed of 表「由…组成」是被动结构；consist of 同义但无被动；compose oneself 是「镇定」，僻义常考
words.pat: Water is composed of hydrogen and oxygen; a judgement is composed of facts and values.
words.patZh: 水由氢和氧组成；一个判断由事实和价值组成。

c: a musical composition 音乐作品
the composition of …的构成
chemical composition 化学成分
fam: compose v. → composition n.
words.dif: composition 兼「创作出的作品」与「构成、成分」；essay 只指文章；component 是部件，别混
words.pat: The composition of a board matters more than the fame of any single member.
words.patZh: 董事会的成员构成，比任何一位成员的名气都重要。

c: fully comprehend 完全理解
comprehend the scale of 理解…的规模
be easily comprehended 易于理解
fam: comprehension n. → comprehensive adj.
words.dif: comprehend 是正式「理解」，语气强于 understand；apprehend 兼表理解与逮捕，形近易混
words.pat: We comprehend the present only by misreading it a little.
words.patZh: 我们对当下的理解，总免不了几分误读。

words.exam: 理解（力）；（听力或阅读）理解测试
c: reading comprehension 阅读理解
beyond comprehension 难以理解
listening comprehension 听力理解
fam: comprehend v. → comprehension n. → comprehensive adj.
words.dif: comprehension 指理解（力）；comprehensive 是形容词「综合的、全面的」——词性不同义不同
words.pat: The failure was not of effort but of comprehension: they were solving the wrong problem.
words.patZh: 失败不在于不努力，而在于理解偏差：他们解错了问题。

c: a comprehensive review 全面审查
comprehensive insurance 综合险
a comprehensive study 全面的研究
fam: comprehend v. → comprehension n. → comprehensive adj.
words.dif: comprehensive 是「全面的」；comprehensible 是「可理解的」——一对形近形容词，差在结尾
words.pat: No comprehensive plan survives its first contact with a single street.
words.patZh: 再全面的规划，也会在碰到第一条街时露出破绽。

c: condemn sth as... 谴责…为…
condemn sb to death 判某人死刑
be widely condemned 受到广泛谴责
fam: condemnation n. → condemned adj. 被判刑的
words.dif: condemn 是强烈谴责，还可用于判刑（condemn to death）；criticize 只是批评，程度轻得多
words.pat: History condemns not only the cruel but also the comfortably silent.
words.patZh: 历史谴责的不只是残忍者，还有那些安逸的沉默者。

c: condense into 浓缩成
condensed milk 炼乳
condense a report 压缩报告
fam: condensation n. → condenser n. 冷凝器
words.dif: condense 兼「气体凝结成液体」与「压缩篇幅」；compress 只指压紧；condescend（屈尊）形近义异
words.pat: A good abstract condenses a hundred pages without losing their argument.
words.patZh: 好的摘要在压缩百页篇幅的同时，不失其论证。

c: living conditions 生活条件
on condition that 条件是
in good condition 状况良好
working conditions 工作环境
fam: conditional adj. 有条件的 → precondition n. 先决条件
words.dif: condition 指事物所处的状态；conditions 复数指环境、条件；on condition that 引导条件状语从句
words.pat: Talent is given; the conditions that let it grow are built.
words.patZh: 天赋是天给的，让它成长的条件是人建的。

c: conduct an experiment 做实验
conduct oneself 举止
conduct electricity 导电
a code of conduct 行为准则
fam: conductor n. → conduction n. 传导 → conductive adj.
words.dif: conduct 作动词重音在后（kənˈdʌkt），作名词重音在前（ˈkɒndʌkt），两词性都高频
words.pat: How a trial is conducted often matters more than what it concludes.
words.patZh: 一场审判如何进行，常常比它得出什么结论更重要。

c: an orchestra conductor 乐队指挥
a bus conductor 公交售票员
a good conductor of heat 热的良导体
fam: conduct v. / n. → conductor n.
words.dif: conductor 三义同源：乐队的指挥、车上的售票员、电的导体，都含「引导者」的核心意象
words.pat: A conductor does not play a single note, yet decides how every note sounds.
words.patZh: 指挥一个音符也不奏，却决定每个音符的音色。

c: be disabled in the war 因战致残
disable the alarm 使警报失灵
a disabling illness 致残的疾病
fam: disabled adj. → disability n. → able → disable v.
words.dif: disable 兼指「使人伤残」与「使设备失灵」；cripple 指人时带冒犯色彩，正式写作宜用 disable
words.pat: One careless update disabled the entire monitoring system.
words.patZh: 一次草率的更新让整个监控系统瘫痪了。

c: disappear from view 从视野中消失
disappear without trace 消失得无影无踪
rapidly disappearing 正在迅速消失
fam: disappearance n. → appear v. → appearance n.
words.dif: disappear 指从视线或存在中消失，可渐可骤；vanish 强调突然彻底消失；fade 指渐渐淡去
words.pat: The middle class does not disappear in a night; it disappears by instalments.
words.patZh: 中产阶级的消失不是一夜之间，而是分期发生的。

c: disappoint sb 使某人失望
be disappointed with / in / at 对…失望
to one's disappointment 令某人失望的是
fam: disappointment n. → disappointed adj. → disappointing adj.
words.dif: disappointed 形容感到失望的人；disappointing 形容令人失望的事物——-ed / -ing 分工是考点
words.pat: The result disappointed the experts, which was precisely why it deserved attention.
words.patZh: 结果让专家们失望了——这正是它值得关注的理由。

c: academic discipline 学科
maintain discipline 维持纪律
self-discipline 自律
a lack of discipline 缺乏自律
fam: disciplined adj. → disciplinary adj. 纪律的 → disciplinarian n. 严师
words.dif: discipline 兼「纪律、自律」与「学科」两义；subject 也指学科，但更口语、泛指科目
words.pat: Self-discipline is choosing what you want most over what you want now.
words.patZh: 自律，是在「最想要的」和「现在想要的」之间选择前者。

c: disclose information 披露信息
disclose sth to sb 向某人透露
publicly disclosed 公开披露的
fam: disclosure n. → close v. → closed adj.
words.dif: disclose 指把隐藏的信息正式公开，多用于财报、法律语境；reveal 泛指揭示、显露
words.pat: The company was fined for failing to disclose what it had known for years.
words.patZh: 这家公司因未披露其早已知情的事实而被罚款。

c: discover the truth 查明真相
discover that... 发现…
newly discovered 新发现的
fam: discovery n. → discoverer n. → undiscovered adj.
words.dif: discover 指发现早已存在之物；invent 指发明创造不存在之物——经典辨析
words.pat: We do not discover who we are by looking inward but by acting outward.
words.patZh: 我们不是靠向内看发现自己是谁，而是靠向外行动。

c: make a discovery 有发现
a scientific discovery 科学发现
the discovery of …的发现
a chance discovery 偶然的发现
fam: discover v. → discovery n. → rediscovery n.
words.dif: discovery 指发现这一行为或结果；invention 指发明；finding 指研究、调查的发现，常用复数
words.pat: Every discovery begins as a question nobody was paid to ask.
words.patZh: 每一项发现，都始于一个没人付钱让人提出的问题。

c: hoist a flag 升旗
hoist cargo 吊起货物
hoist sb to safety 把某人吊到安全处
fam: hoisted → hoisting → hoister n. 起重工
words.dif: hoist 特指用绳索、滑轮吊起重物，可引申为升旗；raise 泛指举起、提高，最通用
words.pat: They hoisted the survivors to safety one rope at a time.
words.patZh: 他们一次一条绳，把幸存者吊到了安全处。

words.exam: 拿着；使保持某种状态（或姿势等）；举行；认为
c: hold on 坚持住
hold that... 认为…
hold up 支撑；延误
hold back 抑制
fam: held（过去式）→ holder n. → holding n. 持股
words.dif: hold 作「认为」是正式用法（experts hold that...）；hold on 表坚持，hold up 表延误，短语动词个个是考点
words.pat: If you hold on long enough, the tide must turn.
words.patZh: 只要坚持得足够久，潮水终会转向。

c: a passport holder 护照持有者
a record holder 纪录保持者
a candle holder 烛台
fam: hold v. → holder n. → holding n.
words.dif: holder 指持有某物的人或器具；owner 强调所有权；bearer 正式，指持票人、持信人
words.pat: A degree is a key; the holder must still find the door.
words.patZh: 学位是一把钥匙，持钥人还得自己找到那扇门。

c: a low-income household 低收入家庭
household income 家庭收入
a household name 家喻户晓的名字
household chores 家务
fam: house + hold → household → householder n. 房主
words.dif: household 指同住一户的人，侧重经济统计单位；family 强调亲属关系
words.pat: In that household, books were furniture before they were education.
words.patZh: 在那个家庭里，书先是家具，然后才是教育。

words.exam: 无论如何；然而；不管用什么方法
c: however + adj. / adv. 无论多么…
but however 然而（句中）
however hard 无论多难
fam: how + ever → however conj. / adv.
words.dif: however 表「然而」时常用逗号与主句隔开；表「无论多么」引导让步从句，语序为 however + 形/副 + 主谓
words.pat: However rational a policy looks, it must still survive contact with a single family.
words.patZh: 一项政策无论看上去多么理性，都得经受住一个具体家庭的检验。

words.exam: 聚集在一起；挤作一团的人
c: huddle together 挤作一团
in a huddle 挤在一起
go into a huddle 聚在一起密谋
fam: huddled → huddling → huddle n. / v.
words.dif: huddle 指因寒冷、恐惧而挤作一团；crowd 只是人多拥挤，不含蜷缩意象
words.pat: The family huddled around one candle and one decision.
words.patZh: 一家人围着一支蜡烛、一个决定挤作一团。

c: a national narrative 国家叙事
control the narrative 掌控话语权
a narrative of decline 衰落叙事
narrative structure 叙事结构
fam: narrate v. → narration n. → narrator n. 叙述者
words.dif: narrative 强调被组织起来的故事框架，常见于媒体、政治语境；story 是日常故事
words.pat: Whoever controls the narrative controls what the facts are taken to mean.
words.patZh: 谁掌控叙事，谁就掌控事实被解读的方式。

c: a narrow escape 九死一生
narrow the gap 缩小差距
a narrow majority 微弱多数
narrow down 缩小范围
fam: narrowly adv. 勉强地 → narrowness n.
words.dif: narrow 的僻义是「勉强的」（a narrow victory），常考；作动词表「使变窄、缩小」也高频
words.pat: The gap between the law and its enforcement narrowed only after the scandal.
words.patZh: 丑闻之后，法律与其执行之间的差距才有所缩小。

c: a nasty shock 沉重的打击
turn nasty 变得险恶
nasty weather 恶劣天气
a nasty cut 严重的伤口
fam: nastily adv. → nastiness n.
words.dif: nasty 兼「脏的」「恶毒的」「严重的」多义，靠搭配定意；filthy 只指肮脏
words.pat: The dispute turned nasty the moment money entered the room.
words.patZh: 钱一进这个房间，争端就变得难听起来。

c: the United Nations 联合国
a sovereign nation 主权国家
the whole nation 全国
across the nation 全国各地
fam: national adj. → nationality n. → nationwide adj.
words.dif: nation 强调民族共同体、国民整体；country 侧重国土；state 侧重政权、政体
words.pat: A nation's character is tested by how it treats those who cannot vote.
words.patZh: 一个国家的品格，体现在它如何对待没有选票的人。

c: national security 国家安全
a national park 国家公园
national identity 民族认同
national economy 国民经济
fam: nation n. → national adj. → nationalism n. → nationalist n.
words.dif: national 兼「国家的」与「民族的」两义，national identity 常指后者；nationwide 只强调全国范围
words.pat: The river was declared a national asset, and the village a national afterthought.
words.patZh: 那条河被宣布为国家资产，而那个村庄成了国家事后的念头。

c: dual nationality 双重国籍
of... nationality …国籍的
change one's nationality 改变国籍
fam: nation → national → nationality n. 相关延伸
words.dif: nationality 指国籍、民族归属；citizenship 指公民身份及权利，法律意义更强
words.pat: Dual nationality is a paperwork question; belonging is not.
words.patZh: 双重国籍是文件问题，归属感不是。

words.exam: 本地的；本国的；天生的；本地人
c: native language 母语
native species 本地物种
a native of 出生于…的人
go native 入乡随俗
fam: nativity n. 出生 → nativism n. 本土主义
words.dif: native 指出生地的或天生的；indigenous 专指原住民的，更正式
words.pat: The native community knew the gorge in a way no map could record.
words.patZh: 本地社区对那条峡谷的了解，是任何地图都记录不下来的。

c: natural resources 自然资源
natural selection 自然选择
a natural leader 天生的领袖
natural disaster 自然灾害
fam: nature n. → natural adj. → naturally adv.
words.dif: natural 兼「自然界的」与「天生的」两义；innate 只指天生固有的，不涉及自然界
words.pat: Curiosity is natural in children and a discipline in adults.
words.patZh: 好奇在孩子身上是天性，在成人身上是一门修炼。

words.exam: 自然界；大自然；性质；天性
c: human nature 人性
by nature 天生地
the nature of …的本质
against nature 违背自然
fam: natural adj. → naturally adv. → naturalism n.
words.dif: nature 兼「大自然」与「性质、本性」两义；character 表性质时与之近义，但 character 还指品格、字符
words.pat: The nature of the problem changed the moment it was given a name.
words.patZh: 问题一被命名，其性质就变了。

words.exam: 全面的；总体的；总体上；总的来说
c: the overall situation 总体形势
overall responsibility 全面责任
overall improvement 总体改善
an overall plan 总体规划
fam: over + all → overall adj. / adv. → overalls n. 工装裤
words.dif: overall 兼形容词与副词；作副词表「总体上」常置句首或句尾；overalls 复数是工装裤，僻义偶考
words.pat: The overall trend is upward, though the road remains steep.
words.patZh: 总体趋势向上，尽管道路依然陡峭。

c: overcome difficulties 克服困难
overcome fear 战胜恐惧
be overcome with emotion 被情感淹没
overcome obstacles 跨越障碍
fam: overcame（过去式）→ overcoming → overcome adj. 被压倒的
words.dif: overcome 的过去式是 overcame；be overcome with 表「被（情感）淹没」，是高频被动用法
words.pat: The obstacle that cannot be overcome can sometimes be outgrown.
words.patZh: 克服不了的障碍，有时可以被成长抛在身后。
